title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

We are seeking a skilled and passionate Embedded Systems Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will have a solid foundation in embedded systems design and development, with a strong proficiency in programming, electronics, and system integration. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and implement robust, efficient, and scalable embedded systems for our next-generation IoT products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build embedded systems including embedded systems firmware.
* Monitor and maintain the system after development.
* Collaborate with Customers to create systems based on their needs.
* Read and interpret schematics, data sheets, and system integration to assist in the development and troubleshooting of electronic systems.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to define hardware-software interfaces and ensure system compatibility.
* Implement firmware and hardware diagnostics to facilitate board bring-up and debugging.
* Test and debug systems followed by writing test scripts/test cases for testing of developed applications .
* Customer support and assistance in deploying systems.
* Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality code standards and documentation.
* Stay updated with the latest technologies and methodologies in embedded systems development to drive innovation within the company.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 2-3 years of experience in embedded systems engineering.
* Strong proficiency in programming with C/C++ and Python .
* Contribute to the development of embedded Linux applications and systems, providing expertise in board bring-up and system optimization.
* Familiarity with Arduino IDE, Python, and other development tools for rapid prototyping and development.
* Hands-on experience with cellular modules, building applications for WiFi, Lorawan and other wireless protocols.
* Experience with applications development consisting of basic communication protocols like MQTT, HTTP, Websockets, etc.
* Basic understanding of electrical and electronics principles, including schematic reading and .
* Experience with Linux and embedded Linux systems is highly desirable.
* Strong knowledge of board bring-up processes and experience in debugging embedded systems.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Financial Systems Engineer-OneStream
description:
**Job Title**

Senior Financial Systems Engineer-OneStream

**Job Description Summary**

**Job Description**

The **Financial Systems Architect** is a key member of the **Technology and Data Solutions (TDS)** team, responsible for supporting and enhancing Cushman & Wakefield's OneStream SaaS platform. This role focuses on ensuring security, governance, stability, and continuous improvement of enterprise financial processes, including financial consolidation, close, reporting, forecasting, planning, and analysis (xP&A).

Working closely with Product Managers, Finance leaders, business stakeholders, and cross-functional technology teams, the Senior Financial Systems Engineer designs, develops, and implements scalable solutions that improve automation, data quality, reporting capabilities, and financial decision-making. Serving as both a technical expert and strategic business partner, this individual translates business requirements into sustainable OneStream solutions through application configuration, business rules, integrations, and platform enhancements.

**Responsibilities**

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Master Data Management, and IT stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
* Drive the delivery of scalable solutions that align with strategic business objectives and enterprise finance transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and business users to define requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap execution.

**Application Configuration & Governance**

* Configure and maintain OneStream metadata, business rules, workflows, dashboards, reporting objects, and application settings.
* Ensure adherence to governance standards, development best practices, and change management processes.
* Support platform upgrades, releases, and ongoing optimization initiatives.

**Financial Close & Reporting Support**

* Provide system support during monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close cycles.
* Participate in consolidation processes, workflow execution, reporting deliverables, and issue resolution to ensure timely and accurate financial results.
* Partner with Finance teams to identify and resolve data, process, and report discrepancies.

**Platform Ownership & Administration**

* Administer and maintain OneStream environments, including Development, Test/Pre-Production, and Production.
* Monitor system performance, availability, and operational health while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate deployments and migration activities across environments.

**Security, Controls & Compliance**

* Support management of application security, role-based access controls, segregation of duties, and user provisioning processes.
* Perform periodic access reviews and support internal and external audit activities.
* Ensure compliance with corporate governance policies, regulatory requirements, and security standards.

**Technical Leadership & Problem Resolution**

* Serve as the point of technical escalation for complex application, data, consolidation, and integration issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions to prevent recurring problems.
* Document system solutions, support procedures, and technical standards.

**Planning, Forecasting & Analytics (xP&A)**

* Support and enhance budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, planning, and analytical capabilities within OneStream.
* Develop solutions that improve planning accuracy, reporting efficiency, and management insights.
* Partner with business stakeholders to expand adoption of xP&A capabilities across the organization.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise financial systems, performance management platforms, or financial close and consolidation applications.
* Strong understanding of financial consolidation, close, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting processes.
* Experience configuring and supporting OneStream or comparable Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with OneStream, Oracle Hyperion, or other EPM solutions.
* Experience with application integrations, data management, workflow design, and data quality controls.
* Knowledge of financial governance, internal controls, compliance, and audit requirements.
* Experience with system performance tuning and optimization.
* Development experience using C#, .NET, or related technologies.
* Experience supporting SaaS-based enterprise applications and cloud environments.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and implement process improvements.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation, standardization, and operational excellence.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Systems Engineer to support and enhance our internal healthcare application platform. You will handle Kubernetes-based application deployments, CI/CD pipeline support, infrastructure automation, platform reliability, and cost optimization. You will work within established standards and security practices.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy, upgrade, and maintain healthcare applications on Kubernetes using standardized patterns and Helm charts.
* Implement, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps practices.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and routine operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Monitor platform health, respond to alerts, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to root cause analysis.
* Identify manual processes and automate them to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities such as rightsizing, cleaning up unused resources, and tuning autoscaling.
* Follow security and compliance practices (HIPAA, access controls, secrets management) in all platform work.
* Maintain runbooks and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with development, operations, and support teams to improve application delivery.

### **Required Skills**

* 3+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, DevOps, or Platform Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized applications.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins.
* Proficiency in Terraform, Ansible, or other IaC tools.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Experience with Azure or another cloud platform.
* Strong troubleshooting, automation, and problem-solving skills.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Experience with AKS, EKS, or OpenShift.
* Helm charts and Kubernetes administration.
* Monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or ELK.
* Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments.
* Certifications such as CKA/CKAD, Azure Administrator, or Terraform Associate.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Applications are deployed consistently using standardized Kubernetes patterns.
* Automation has measurably reduced manual work.
* Platform reliability has improved and incidents are resolved faster.
* Cost-saving actions have been delivered and documented.
* Runbooks and documentation are kept current.

title: Sr Systems Engineer
description:
**Senior Systems Engineer**

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to lead the design, scalability, and reliability of our internal healthcare application platform. This role owns Kubernetes platform standards, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategy, operational excellence, and cost optimization. The role also mentors engineers and partners with development and leadership teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, own, and evolve the Kubernetes platform architecture for healthcare applications, including cluster strategy, upgrades, and multi-environment standards.
* Define and enforce standardized deployment patterns using Helm, Kustomize, and GitOps (e.g., Argo CD or Flux).
* Architect enterprise CI/CD pipelines with built-in security scanning, quality gates, and release governance.
* Lead IaC strategy with reusable Terraform modules, configuration management, and policy-as-code.
* Establish observability standards, SLOs/SLIs, and alerting. Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.
* Drive platform security and compliance (HIPAA, audit readiness, secrets management, RBAC, network policies, image hardening).
* Own cloud cost governance (FinOps): rightsizing, autoscaling, reserved capacity, and cost reporting, with measurable savings.
* Plan and test disaster recovery, backup, and high availability.
* Mentor engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and author technical documentation and runbooks.
* Partner with development, security, and leadership teams on the platform roadmap and technical decisions.

### **Required Skills**

* 5+ years in Systems Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering, including 3+ years running Kubernetes in production.
* Expert-level Kubernetes administration (AKS, EKS, or OpenShift), Docker, Kustomize and Helm.
* Proven experience designing CI/CD at scale with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins.
* Advanced Terraform skills (module design, state management) plus Ansible or similar tools.
* Strong scripting and automation in PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Deep Azure experience (networking, identity, security, cost management); multi-cloud is a plus.
* Hands-on observability experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or ELK.
* Track record of leading production incidents and delivering reliability improvements.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2).
* GitOps, service mesh (Istio or Linkerd), and policy engines (OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno).
* FinOps practices and cloud cost tooling (Kubecost, Azure Cost Management).
* Relevant certifications: CKA/CKS, Azure Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, Terraform Associate.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* A standardized, self-service Kubernetes platform adopted across application teams.
* Defined SLOs met consistently, with reduced incident frequency and faster recovery (MTTR).
* Majority of infrastructure and deployments fully automated through IaC and GitOps.
* Audit-ready platform security and compliance posture.
* Documented, measurable infrastructure cost savings.
* Stronger team capability through mentoring, standards, and documentation.

title: Principle Systems Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to help build and scale our Azure-native cloud platform as we migrate services from an on-premises data center to the cloud. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong mentoring component - you will design and build alongside the team while raising the technical bar for engineers earlier in their careers. You will work across infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, and security tooling, with exposure to both legacy automation modernization and net-new platform capability.

This is an individual contributor role. You will not have direct reports, but you will be expected to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers on the team, including reviewing designs, pairing on complex problems, and setting technical direction by example.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

· Design and build Azure infrastructure using a cloud native approach, leveraging managed services wherever they meet reliability and cost requirements.

· Lead technical execution of the migration of services from an on-premises data center to Azure, including dependency mapping, migration sequencing, and cutover risk management.

· Operate and extend our AKS-based platform, including GitOps deployment patterns, namespace isolation, and policy enforcement.

· Own and evolve reusable Terraform modules that other engineering teams consume, with clear interface contracts between platform-owned and application-owned infrastructure.

· Build and maintain observability coverage (metrics, logs, alerting) so that platform and application health are measurable and actionable, not just instrumented.

· Apply policy-as-code to enforce security, compliance, and operational standards across the platform, and reduce reliance on manual review gates.

· Design and review Identity and Access Management patterns, including workload identity, least-privilege access models, and secrets management - with a clear bias away from static credentials.

· Participate in business continuity and disaster recovery planning for platform services, including failover design, RTO/RPO definition, and recovery testing.

· Contribute to CI/CD pipeline design and standards used across engineering teams building on the platform.

· Use AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of the standard workflow, and evaluate where AI-driven platform capabilities (automated remediation, intelligent alerting, natural-language operational tooling) can be responsibly introduced into the platform itself.

· Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code/design review, pairing, and informal technical coaching. Help less experienced engineers build sound judgment around idempotency, error handling, and migration candidacy when evaluating legacy automation.

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

title: Electronic Systems Engineer - Software
description:
**Job Summary:**

This entry level/early career professional, applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and supports the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and collaborates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

**Competencies:**

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

**Experience:**

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

* Support Transitioning PSBU products to Phase 35 software (Core 2)

* Requires collaboration with resources in US, India, UK and China, provides great global experience.

* Support Global VPI software development to meet T4 and StgV emissions

* Convert PSBU owned Phase 25 and Phase 32 components to be Phase 35 compatible

* Simulink, Matlab, C, Integrity, C2ST experience is necessary.

* Basic Bench testing knowledge would be added advantage

* Basic awareness about system integration of engine and its applications

* Own the administration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of Windows Server 2012/2016/2019/2022/2025 environments.
